Awarapan 2 () is an upcoming Indian Hindi-language crime romantic action film written by Bilal Siddiqui and directed by Nitin Kakkar. It is  produced by Mukesh Bhatt and Vishesh Bhatt under Vishesh Films. A sequel to the 2007 film Awarapan, it stars Emraan Hashmi, Disha Patani, and Shabana Azmi.
The film is scheduled to release on 14 August 2026, coinciding with the Indian Independence Day.

* Emraan Hashmi

Production
Development
The film was officially announced by Vishesh Films in March 2025, with Nitin Kakkar signed as the director and Emraan Hashmi in the lead role.
Casting
Initially, Manushi Chhillar was considered for the female lead, but declined due to scheduling conflicts. Later on, Disha Patani was cast as the female lead. In December 2025, Shabana Azmi joined the cast.
Filming
Principal photography began in September 2025. The film was shot in Bangkok, Mumbai, Rajasthan, and Malaysia.
Release
Awarapan 2 was initially scheduled to release on 3 April 2025, however it was postponed to 14 August 2026, coinciding with the Indian Independence Day.
